mapper.select: SELECT game_id, damage_type_key, name, description, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM public.damage_types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND damage_type_key = #{damageTypeKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.damage_types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND lower(btrim(name)) = lower(btrim(#{name}))
AND damage_type_key <> #{excludeDamageTypeKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.damage_types SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND damage_type_key = #{damageTypeKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.damage_types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND damage_type_key = #{damageTypeKey}
